messages:
maya: Hey team — customer reported invoice > dashboard served tokens by ~22%. They show lots of short chat requests, model rtx-4k, continuous-batcher enabled. Can we triage?
liam: Thanks, Maya. Do we have example request traces or a replay?
maya: Pasted a minimal repro below from customer (sanitized):
maya: ```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "rtx-4k",
  "messages": [{"role": "user","content": "Summarize: I like tea"}],
  "stream": false
}
```
maya: They were sending ~6k of these per hour with cbatcher.window_ms=40 and prefetch=on.
priya: Quick hypothesis: continuous-batcher merges requests and prefetch primes KV cache; billing is counting prefetch token work as metered even if later served from KV cache. That would inflate billed tokens vs served.
liam: I pulled service logs for their org id -> see cbatcher events: `cbatch.merge_count=187` and entries: `prefetch.tokens=18` for many batches. Example log snippet: `TRACE cbatch: ids=[u1,u2], merged=2, prefetch_tokens=36, served_tokens=14`.
liam: So engine billed for the prefetch_tokens when compute happened, but response sizes (served_tokens) were lower because KV hits avoided generation.
noah: Does our billing pipeline use metered_tokens = compute_input_tokens + compute_output_tokens_at_compute_time? Or does it deduct cache hits later? Need clarity before issuing credits.
liam: Current infra increments metered_tokens at generation invocation time (compute_start) — prefetch counts. We have a separate served_tokens metric emitted at response finish. So gaps are expected when prefetch + cache shadowing occurs.
maya: Customer: "we were charged for tokens even though dashboard shows fewer served" — they want explanation and potential credit for the excess.
priya: Short-term mitigation: suggest they set `prefetch=false` or increase cbatch.window_ms so fewer prefetches. Longer-term: we should (A) attribute prefetch work separately in billing pipeline and (B) de-duplicate prefetch work when KV cache avoids generation.
noah: For this customer I can propose a one-off credit while eng patches attribution. How much to credit? We need conservative estimate. Liam, can you run a small replay on staging with same request shape to estimate prefetch:billed ratio?
liam: On it — I'll replay 10k requests with window_ms=40 and prefetch=true and capture `metered_tokens` vs `served_tokens`. ETA 30m.
deploy-bot: deploy started: cbatcher/kv-prefetch-instrumentation -> staging (liam)
liam: Replay results: metered=1,120,000 tokens, served=880,000 tokens -> delta ~27%. Matches customer's ~22% (within noise). Logs show most deltas from prefetch for short prompts (~10-30 tokens).
noah: OK. I'll file a support credit for 25% of billed tokens for the billing period and include note about configuration change.
maya: I'll message customer with: explanation + mitigation (prefetch toggle) + offer credit and timeline for eng fix.
liam: Follow-ups for eng: (1) emit `billing_role=prefetch` tag in metered_events, (2) change billing pipeline to optionally attribute prefetch separately, (3) consider switching to billing_on_serve behavioral flag. I'll track in GH issue.
priya: Also flag SRE: prefetch causes load spikes when many short requests merge; consider a per-org prefetch throttle.
maya: Customer accepted the credit offer and disabled prefetch while we fix. Closing once GH issue created and credit applied. :white_check_mark:
noah: Credit ticket created #BILL-4827. Eng issue #INF-3345.
liam: Created INF-3345 with repro + logs + suggested schema changes. Assigning to runtime team.
maya: Thanks everyone, closing thread.
